description: SEC EDGAR filings search: latest 10-K/10-Q/8-K (or any form) for a company by name, ticker or CIK, with direct document and filing-index links; or full-text search across all EDGAR filings since 2001 (?q=), optionally scoped to one company, form types and a date range. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sec-edgar-search

company.description: Company name, ticker (AAPL, BRK-B) or CIK (320193). Required unless q is given.

forms.description: Comma-separated form types, e.g. 10-K,10-Q,8-K,S-1,DEF 14A, or "all". Default 10-K,10-Q,8-K for company mode, all for full-text.

q.description: Full-text search phrase (EDGAR FTS, quotes for exact phrase), e.g. "share repurchase"

name: sec_edgar_search
title: Sec Edgar Search
